summary: Section 4 (Accessibility & Performance floor) frontend a11y audit — all 3 role sign-ins pass and no functional regressions found in the tab switching/memoization/back navigation. However, most of the Section 4 a11y DOM assertions FAIL on RN Web 0.21: the toast component, the internal ProjectDetail TabBar, and the ProjectDetail back button do NOT emit their intended ARIA attributes to the DOM. Bottom-nav tabs (rendered by expo-router) DO correctly emit role='tab'/aria-selected and are ≥48px tall; that's the only path where Section 4 a11y actually works today. UnitSpectrumBar SR summary and dark-theme Ledger/Reconciliation semantic tokens could not be fully verified because the seed environment has no project with committed units and no investor with a CONFIRMED invite (5cafd920 still returns 'Invite not found' for investor@ribhshare.com — pre-existing from iter_10/11). LM→Investor→CEO end-to-end regression was not fully exercisable for the same reason. NO functional regressions were introduced; the memo() wrapping did not break Audit/Ledger/Reconciliation tabs (they render and switch as expected on the one accessible LM project).

ui_bugs.issue: The Toast Animated.View's role, aria-live, aria-atomic props and ToastProvider's <View role='region' aria-label='Notifications'> do NOT reach the DOM on RN Web 0.21. Verified by triggering the 'Wrong email or password' error toast at /sign-in: only ONE role='alert' element exists on the page and it belongs to the inline sign-in error card (SignInScreen), not to the Toast at the bottom-left. document.querySelector('[role="region"][aria-label="Notifications"]') returns null. Screen readers will therefore not announce toast notifications as advertised.

ui_bugs.component: TabBar (inner ProjectDetail tabs: Overview/Documents/Risks/Timeline/Investors, plus Profits/Reconciliation/Audit/Ledger on active projects)
ui_bugs.issue: Neither accessibilityRole='tab' nor the raw role='tab'/aria-selected props on the TabBar's Pressable reach the DOM. Ancestry walk (10 levels) from the visible 'Overview' text yields only unstyled DIVs with role=null and aria-selected=null. Only 4 role='tab' elements exist on the ProjectDetail page and all 4 belong to the bottom-nav (expo-router Tabs). This means screen readers cannot navigate the ProjectDetail tab list as a proper tablist. The tabs remain visually functional and switching works, but the a11y contract fails.

accessibilityLabel='Go back' does not translate to aria-label on the rendered DOM. document.querySelector('[aria-label="Go back"]') returns null on /projects/{id}. In fact zero aria-label attributes exist anywhere on the ProjectDetail page. The Pressable IS 44×44 (styles.backBtn: minWidth/minHeight 44 — passes visually) but the a11y label is not exposed to AT.

Could NOT verify at runtime because no project in the seed environment has committed units (hassanu project is 0/50 subscribed). Code review confirms the srSummary Text with accessibilityLabel + aria-label is present and styles.srOnly {position:absolute,width:1,height:1,overflow:hidden,left:-9999} is a valid clip pattern, BUT given that RN Web 0.21 is stripping accessibilityLabel elsewhere (see back button bug), the aria-label on this Text will almost certainly ALSO be missing at runtime. Needs a project with pledged units to confirm.

design_issues.screen: Sign-in error toast vs inline error card
issues: The inline sign-in error card uses role='alert' with aria-live='polite'. Per Section 4's Toast policy (errors → assertive), this inline card should be aria-live='assertive' if it is an error. The mismatch will confuse screen-reader users about which errors are urgent.

action_items: HIGH: Investigate why RN Web 0.21 is dropping raw role/aria-* HTML props AND accessibilityLabel/accessibilityRole on Pressable/Animated.View/View for our custom components (Toast, TabBar, ProjectDetail back button) while it works for expo-router's own Tabs. Likely root causes: (a) RN Web 0.21 no longer forwards unknown web-only props on Animated.View/Pressable/ScrollView; (b) accessibilityRole='tab' may not be a supported mapping in this RN Web version, silently dropped. Consider Platform.OS==='web' branches that render native <button role='tab' aria-selected={...}> / <div role='alert' aria-live='assertive'> wrappers, OR upgrade to react-native-a11y utility, OR use `dataSet`+CSS pseudo-elements. Verify one component (e.g. TabBar) end-to-end in the DOM before propagating the fix.

HIGH: Fix Toast + ToastProvider so that role, aria-live, aria-atomic and aria-label='Notifications' actually reach the DOM. Confirm by triggering a success and an error toast and reading DOM attributes.
HIGH: Fix ProjectDetail back button so aria-label='Go back' reaches DOM. Same pattern will need to be applied to any other back buttons in the app (Profile, Portfolio, Statements sub-screens).

MEDIUM: Align the sign-in inline error card's aria-live to 'assertive' (currently 'polite') so it matches the Toast policy — errors should interrupt.

critical_code_review_comments: Toast.tsx wraps role/aria-live on Animated.View, but Animated.View in RN Web 0.21 does NOT forward unknown web props. Use <View aria-live=... aria-atomic=... role={ariaRole}> as the outermost element (or a Platform.OS==='web' <div>), and let Animated.View sit INSIDE it — then the ARIA attributes are guaranteed to render.

TabBar.tsx sets role='tab' + accessibilityRole='tab' on Pressable. Neither is reaching the DOM. Recommend rendering a Platform.OS==='web' <button role='tab' aria-selected={active} aria-disabled={disabled} tabIndex={active?0:-1}> and delegating onPress to onClick on web. This also fixes the wraparound tablist keyboard navigation which is currently missing.

ProjectDetailScreen.tsx line 513: back button uses only accessibilityRole/accessibilityLabel — no raw aria-label. Add aria-label='Go back' explicitly (Platform.OS==='web') until the RN Web mapping is verified. Also consider hitSlop for mobile parity.

ToastProvider.tsx: role='region' + aria-label='Notifications' on <View> is not making it to the DOM (0 [role=region] elements found). Replace with a web-only <div> wrapper on Platform.OS==='web'. Otherwise SR users have no announcement region.

UnitSpectrumBar srOnly pattern (position:absolute; left:-9999) is fine in principle, but RN Web will render the Text as a <div>. Verify aria-label='...' actually surfaces on it — if not, add a Platform.OS==='web' <span aria-label={srSummary} class='sr-only'/>. Also consider `speak-as: never` on the coloured bar so SR doesn't announce empty <div>s.

Earnings screen backgroundImage guard is fine — no shorthand warnings observed in the console during LM home + navigation to Earnings tab (only pre-existing `props.pointerEvents is deprecated` and `Require cycle CreateProjectWizard <-> CreateProjectStepDocuments` warnings remain).
General: consider adding a small integration test (Playwright) that asserts specific ARIA attributes on Toast/TabBar/BackButton — this section keeps regressing because it is only visually verified.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Section 4 acceptance criteria that PASS at DOM level: bottom-nav tabs (5 role='tab' entries on investor, 4-5 on LM/CEO, h≈48px, aria-selected correct); TabBar minHeight 44 CSS applied (verified visually on hassanu inner tabs — clickable region ≈40-48px tall); Earnings hero renders without background-shorthand warnings; NO functional regression in tab switching or memoized tables. Section 4 criteria that FAIL at DOM level: (a) Toast — role/aria-live/aria-atomic not on DOM; ToastProvider region not on DOM; (b) TabBar inner ProjectDetail tabs — no role='tab'/aria-selected on DOM; (c) Back button — no aria-label='Go back' on DOM; (d) UnitSpectrumBar — not verifiable in this env, code path looks correct but same RN Web forwarding concern applies. Root cause is likely RN Web 0.21 not forwarding raw role/aria-* HTML props on Animated.View/Pressable/View and not mapping accessibilityRole='tab' the way we expect. Recommend Platform.OS==='web' native DOM wrappers or an accessibility HOC. Once fixed, re-run this iteration's script to confirm role/aria-* now appear.
rca of the issue: The Section 4 code changes assume that raw ARIA props (role, aria-live, aria-atomic, aria-selected, aria-label) and RN accessibility props (accessibilityRole='tab', accessibilityLabel) applied to Animated.View / Pressable / ScrollView / View will surface on the DOM in RN Web 0.21. Empirically they do not (0 aria-labels on ProjectDetail page; only expo-router's own Tabs emit role='tab'). The Section 4 PR therefore compiles cleanly and looks right in the source but the resulting DOM does not have the intended a11y attributes. Reproduction: sign in as LM → /projects/{id} → run document.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]').length → returns 4 (bottom-nav only) instead of the expected 4+5 (bottom-nav + inner tabs). Same for [aria-label='Go back'] and [role='region'][aria-label='Notifications']. Mitigation: wrap the affected components in Platform.OS==='web' branches that render native <div>/<button> with explicit aria-* attributes, since RN Web 0.21's implicit mapping is unreliable for these props.
